ZPOOL-SYNC(8)                System Manager's Manual              ZPOOL-SYNC(8)

NAME
       zpool-sync — flush data to primary storage of ZFS storage pools

SYNOPSIS
       zpool sync [pool]…

DESCRIPTION
       This  command forces all in-core dirty data to be written to the primary
       pool storage and not the ZIL.  It will also update administrative infor‐
       mation including quota reporting.  Without arguments,  zpool  sync  will
       sync  all  pools on the system.  Otherwise, it will sync only the speci‐
       fied pools.

SEE ALSO
       zpoolconcepts(7), zpool-export(8), zpool-iostat(8)

OpenZFS                          August 9, 2019                   ZPOOL-SYNC(8)
